howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Whether you are renting a car, hiring a driver, or listing your vehicle — the process is straightforward.
howItWorks.renterSearchDesc: Enter your location and dates. Browse cars and drivers in your area with prices and trust badges.
howItWorks.renterChooseDesc: Compare listings by price, vehicle type, driver rating, and proximity. Read reviews from other customers.
howItWorks.renterBookDesc: Send pickup, dates, duration, and a phone number. renting.rw confirms Standard bookings. Extra Premium listings book instantly.
howItWorks.renterEnjoyDesc: Pick up your car or meet your driver. After confirmation you get the provider name and phone by SMS and email.
howItWorks.ownerListDesc: Create a listing with photos, price, and availability. You go live after your hoster plan is active.
howItWorks.ownerLiveDesc: Subscribe so your cars or driver profile appear in search. Extra Premium adds the verified badge and instant booking.
howItWorks.ownerConfirmDesc: The renting.rw desk calls the provider for Standard bookings. Extra Premium is instant. After confirm, both sides get name and phone.
howItWorks.ownerEarnDesc: Earn on your terms. Completed trips and reviews raise your public trust score and visibility.
howItWorks.trustTitle: Powered by a public trust score
howItWorks.trustDesc: Every hoster and driver has a visible trust score from booking history and reviews. Higher scores mean more visibility.

safety.title: Your safety comes first
safety.subtitle: renting.rw is built around subscriptions, a public trust score, and a booking desk — so every trip is accountable.
safety.planDesc: Hosters, drivers, and taxi drivers appear in search after an active plan. Extra Premium is the verified badge, with instant booking and public contact.
safety.trustDesc: Every provider has a visible trust score from completed bookings and reviews. Low scores reduce visibility.
safety.payDesc: Payments go through iPay (mobile money and card). renting.rw never stores card PINs or full card numbers.
safety.contactDesc: After a booking is confirmed, you receive the provider name and phone by SMS and email. Taxi numbers stay public on the listing.
safety.disputeDesc: Support mediates disputes using booking history and photos. Both parties are protected.
safety.supportDesc: In an emergency during a trip, call 0788 781 648. We are available every day including weekends.
safety.renterTip1: Check that the car or driver matches the listing before you start.
safety.renterTip2: Photograph existing damage before you drive.
safety.renterTip3: Never share payment PINs. Pay only through renting.rw.
safety.renterTip4: Share trip details with someone you trust.
safety.renterTip5: After confirmation, use the shared phone number and keep a record of pickup details.
safety.renterTip6: If something feels wrong, stop and contact support immediately.
safety.ownerTipsTitle: Safety tips for car owners & drivers
safety.ownerTip1: Keep your calendar current. Standard bookings are confirmed by the renting.rw desk.
safety.ownerTip2: Photograph the vehicle before and after every rental.
safety.ownerTip3: Set a reasonable security deposit for your vehicle.
safety.ownerTip4: Keep valid insurance and papers before you list.
safety.ownerTip5: Report suspicious activity to support immediately.
safety.ownerTip6: Update availability so you do not get double-booked.
safety.emergencyDesc: Call our support line or email us and we will respond as fast as possible.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Booking, payments, listing, and trust on renting.rw.
faq.stillDesc: Support is available every day. Call or email and we will help.
faq.bookingQ1: How do I make a booking?
faq.bookingA1: Search for a car or driver, choose dates, pickup location, and phone number, then send the request. renting.rw confirms Standard bookings. Extra Premium cars book instantly.
faq.bookingA2: Standard requests go to the renting.rw desk. We call the provider, then confirm and share their contact by SMS and email. Extra Premium listings confirm immediately.
faq.bookingA3: Yes, from your dashboard. Cancellations within 24 hours of the trip start may affect your trust score. Read the cancellation note on each listing.
faq.bookingQ4: What if the owner cancels on me?
faq.bookingA4: If a confirmed booking is cancelled by the provider, you get a refund and their trust score is affected. Contact support if you need another option.
faq.payA1: Payment is collected at confirmation. We support mobile money (MTN MoMo, Airtel Money) and cards via iPay.
faq.payA2: Yes. Payments are processed by iPay. renting.rw never stores card PINs or full card numbers.
faq.payA3: No. The listing shows the daily rate. Extra charges (fuel, countryside rates, deposits) are disclosed on the listing before you book.
faq.ownerQ1: How do I list my car?
faq.ownerA1: Sign up, complete the hoster onboarding, choose a plan, then add photos, daily rate, and availability.
faq.ownerQ2: Is there a fee to list?
faq.ownerA2: Yes. Hoster plans: Basic 10,000 RWF/month (1 car), Premium 25,000 (5 cars), Extra Premium 50,000 (unlimited, verified badge, instant booking, public contact). Promo codes can reduce or waive the fee.
faq.ownerA3: Payouts go to the mobile money number on your profile, usually within 24–48 hours after a booking is marked complete.
faq.ownerQ4: What if a renter damages my car?
faq.ownerA4: Document the car with photos. Contact support with the booking and we will mediate.
faq.trustQ1: How does the trust score work?
faq.trustA1: Your score comes from completed bookings, reviews, and events like no-shows or late responses. It is public on your profile, with green / yellow / red colour.
faq.trustQ2: What does the verified badge mean?
faq.trustA2: Verified means Extra Premium — not a separate identity form. Extra Premium listings can book instantly and may show public contact.
faq.trustQ3: What if I have a problem during a trip?
faq.trustA3: Call 0788 781 648 or email renting.rw@gmail.com. After confirmation you also have the provider phone number.
